caption: Figure 13-1. The Storage panel after the corpora mount was approved
alt: The Storage panel listing the corpora mount with its health, the cache use and the pinned dataset versions.

regions.label: Mounts
regions.note: Every place Cadence may read audio from. Adding one was an approval; a mount is never edited in place — a different root is a new mount.

regions.label: Health
regions.note: A worker checks the mount: reachable, free space, a throughput sample. A job never starts on an unhealthy mount, and Check health re-runs the test.

regions.label: Cache
regions.note: The local copies jobs made. Above 85 % Cadence evicts the least recently used copies that also exist on a mount, down to 70 %. 'evictable 0 B': nothing cached here exists anywhere else yet, so nothing may go.

regions.label: Quota
regions.note: What the project's frozen dataset versions occupy against its quota; a freeze that would pass it is refused before it starts.

regions.label: Pinned by
regions.note: A dataset a golden set is built on, or that a queued run reads, is pinned: the sweep never evicts it.
